categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies wallet RPC implementation in src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a signed integer overflow crash in `listtransactions` that causes an out-of-bounds iterator access and bus error when `count + skip` exceeds `INT_MAX`. As noted in the description, calling `bitcoin-cli -regtest listtransactions "*" 2147483647 1` crashes the node on master due to UBSan-reported signed integer overflow and ASan-reported bus error in `UniValue::push_backV`.
